Key asks: full Private (VPC) deployment in AWS us-east-2; KMS integration for customer-managed keys (Bring-Your-Own-Key); audit logging exported to customer Splunk; data residency for EU and NA editorial corpora; DPA + SCCs required; pen-test report or on-site pen test; SLA 99.9 latency-aware for interactive editor flows.
